Provenance shows 36/36 claims covered at tier2. The new paragraph references data already present in the registry (sweep-isr-b005, sweep-isr-b02, plan002-b01, plan002-b03 entries), so no new provenance gaps were introduced.

Added a 3-sentence "Non-monotonic dose-response" paragraph at the end of §4.3 (lines 119-122), summarizing: deterministic collapse at β=0.05 and β=0.2, multi-modal instability at β=0.3, and β=0.1 as the sole dose with a genuine window, framed as a threshold interaction between β and rollout stochasticity.
